g.text: PLANET DEFENSES · where a siege's hits land, in order
Up to 3, from the Autofactory (40,000¢). 150 hit points each; each adds 4 weapon mounts. Missiles do double against them.
Each moon gives 6 free mounts for railguns, missile racks and point defense. Moons can't be destroyed; the weapons on them can.
Outside the shield, so they're hit early.
Up to 5 levels, 60 each. Regains 10% of its strength every round. Railguns do a quarter against it; missiles double.
Up to 20 plates, 50 each. Repair bots mend 5 a round each. Railguns do double.
